description: Undoes one logged contact change from its Activity Log row, as the row's Undo does: restores the old values of an edited contact, puts a Quo card back to how it was, or splits a merged contact back out. activity_id comes from read (entity activity log). force undoes anyway when a later change conflicts (the row answers conflict without it). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat answers already_undone with the first undo.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: undo_contact_change
title: Undo a logged contact change
